decision.reason: Closed-loop outcome gate did not pass; keep adapter opt-in.

limits: The environment and agent are synthetic research systems.
This compares one fixed agent initialization; repeated seed episodes do not establish generalization across agent weights.
Online prediction errors are on-policy and state distributions can differ between arms; they are descriptive only.
No default promotion follows from this assay, even if its narrow gate passes.

protocol.admission_rule: reward-delta 95% seed-bootstrap lower bound > 0.05 and survival-delta lower bound > -0.02
protocol.candidate: same agent with receipt-validated contextual residual adapter
protocol.paired_control: same environment seed, same agent base seed, fresh reset per arm; event schedule fixed by the world seed
protocol.primary_outcome: per-episode total reward delta, candidate minus baseline
